title: Post-arrival drift continuation at filing arrivals: sector-residual initial-reaction continuation books on the death-inclusive cohort (limited-attention gradual-diffusion lineage; the PEAD analog built without consensus data)
mechanism: WHO is the constrained actor: the attention-constrained marginal investor — individuals and small institutions with bounded information-processing capacity. A periodic filing arrival is a large, verbose, hard-to-process information release with no salience cue: it arrives off-calendar for most of the audience, its content must be extracted from structured documents, and competing disclosures crowd the same windows (Hirshleifer-Teoh limited attention, 2003; Hirshleifer-Lim-Teoh 2009). WHY the reaction is slow/attenuated: under gradual-information-diffusion dynamics (Hong-Stein 1999) and under/overreaction dynamics of news watchers (Daniel-Hirshleifer-Subrahmanyam 1998), the first post-arrival price move incorporates only PART of the arrival's firm-specific content; the remainder enters the price as later agents observe the drift itself and as the information is re-derived, producing continuation of the initial direction over the following weeks. This is the post-earnings-announcement-drift analog for periodic filings, with one honest subtraction: this panel contains NO consensus estimates and therefore no measured surprise; the only available news proxy is the market's own initial reaction to the arrival. The mechanism claim is therefore stated exactly: the market's 5-bar sector-residual reaction to a filing arrival is an INCOMPLETE first estimate of the arrival's firm-specific content, and its direction continues to diffuse over the subsequent 15 bars; the arrival instant (V11-E1 evidenced first_avail stamp) is the conditioning event, and the traded object is the post-arrival path — an event-time book, not a characteristic rank. WHAT the book does: at each evidenced filing arrival of an in-universe entity, after the arrival's first 5 STRICT_NEXT_BAR bars close, the book takes a long (short) position if the 5-bar sector-residual reaction is positive (negative), entered at the bar-6 close and exited at the bar-20 close; positions are dollar-neutralized within sector at each date with CASH absorbing imbalance, so the book isolates firm-specific reaction dispersion and carries ~no sector beta. WHEN it must fail: (i) if the sham-event placebo — the same sign/hold arithmetic applied at deterministic hash-seeded non-filing windows matched in 20-bar length, containing no filer-event date — reproduces the anchor at >= 0.5x expectancy same sign, the drift is generic short-horizon continuation mechanics, not arrival-anchored diffusion, and the family DIES (the V5 sham-calendar lesson, imported as this lane's mandatory falsification); (ii) if pooled D2 Spearman |rho| > 0.20 vs any of the eleven veto entries (primary declared risk: generic cross-sectional 63-session momentum — the reaction sign shares short-horizon return content with it), the proposal is INELIGIBLE before selection; (iii) if the anchor passes base gates but dies at stress x2 costs, the diffusion remainder does not survive band costs on this cohort and the family is rejected at Stage-A honestly.
falsifiable_prediction: Directional and falsifiable, frozen before any PnL exists: (a) the anchor book's long-short expectancy is > 0 per scored decision after base band costs, with position PF >= 1.10; (b) at least 2 of 3 folds have positive expectancy, no populated fold has PF < 0.8, and max fold MDD <= 0.15; (c) SPY-excess book return is positive overall and in >= 2 of 3 folds, and the declared sector-matched excess is positive in >= 2 of 3 folds — beta alone cannot pass (the V2 lesson); (d) THE MANDATORY FALSIFIER: the sham-event placebo control does NOT reproduce the anchor — control expectancy is < 0.5x anchor expectancy in absolute value OR opposite in sign; if the sham placebo reaches >= 0.5x of the anchor's expectancy with the same sign, the family DIES — a reaction mechanism must beat its own placebo calendar; additionally a control that outperforms a negative anchor in the anchor's direction falsifies the family; (e) the neighbour (SPY-residual reaction variant) supports the same sign; if the neighbour flips sign while the anchor passes, the record states the effect is sector-relative repricing, not market-relative firm information, and the family is recorded as mechanism-mistitled rather than rescued; (f) anchor-vs-control position-vector Spearman rho < 0.95 measured pre-selection (they share the sign-of-reaction arithmetic, so a modest positive rho is declared expected, 0.0-0.3; rank identity is forbidden); (g) pooled Spearman |rho| <= 0.20 vs ALL ELEVEN veto entries measured at D2 pre-selection on the pairs where the exposure is defined. If any of (a)-(g) fails, the family is rejected and arrival-conditioned drift continuation is declared untradable on this cohort at these costs; every failure mode is a successful research outcome.

market_leg_inputs: DECLARED: entity EOD prices enter the reaction measurement, the eligibility floors (ADV63, close floor, bar counts) and the fills; SPY and the 11 SPDR sector ETF EOD series (verified-by-pin in the price store) enter (a) the residualization of the 5-bar reaction (signal input) and (b) the incremental-alpha benchmarks — they are never book legs in any arm

clock.as_of_semantics: an arrival's conditioning quantities use only bars with date > first_avail (STRICT_NEXT_BAR, the P2 default convention, declared ex-ante; SAME_DAY_INCLUSIVE is not used; controls recompute under any semantics change per P-3); the signal for an event uses bars 1-5 post-arrival and the entry fill occurs at the bar-6 close, so no fill ever executes on a bar whose close is a signal input
clock.mutation_invariant_accepted: the family accepts the P3 event-book lag mutation: pushing a filing stamp later shifts the arrival and its entire book window exactly one period and changes nothing else; any drift of the book that is not exactly one period is a leak verdict

warmup_decisions.justification: all conditioning is event-anchored: the arrival stamp and its post-arrival bars are the inputs, and the sector-ETF residualization uses contemporaneous bars — no history-accumulating norm exists in any arm; the 63-bar ADV63 window is inherited tradability eligibility (band resolution needs it), not warmup, per the V9/V10 level-arm precedent

decision_grid.grid: event-time decisions inside the frozen folds: S0_FOLD_1 2018-04-04..2020-09-01, S0_FOLD_2 2020-09-10..2023-02-09, S0_FOLD_3 2023-02-17..2025-07-24; an event belongs to the fold containing its first_avail; a scored decision is a calendar date on which >= 1 entry fill executes and the book holds >= 1 non-CASH leg
decision_grid.boundary_handling: positions whose bar-20 exit would fall after the fold's last session are force-flat at the fold's last session close with cost charged; arrivals with first_avail in the inter-fold gaps (2020-09-02..2020-09-09, 2023-02-10..2023-02-16) or outside all folds are excluded-with-reason and counted at dry-run
decision_grid.deviation: the inherited 21-session periodic grid is NOT used — this is the lane's defining deviation: decision instants are arrival-anchored (entry at each event's bar-6 close), which is what makes the book a REACTION-form book rather than a characteristic book on a periodic grid (veto entry 10)

entry_exit_fills.entry: per event: signal = sign of the 5-bar sector-residual reaction over STRICT bars 1-5 post-arrival; entry fill at the RAW close of bar 6; if two arrivals of the same entity produce overlapping holds, the prior position is closed at the new arrival's bar-6 close (cost charged) and the new position opens — latest-arrival-wins, declared ex-ante; at most one active position per entity per date
entry_exit_fills.fill_check_preregistered: a fill references only names with a bar at the fill session; a missing bar means the order does not exist — no silent substitute pricing
entry_exit_fills.exit_preregistered: exit fill at the RAW close of bar 20 post-arrival (guaranteed to exist by the >= 20-bar bookable threshold); fold-boundary force-flat exits at the fold's last session close; exit-at-last-close semantics carried for any leg whose series ends, with the delisting return carried by the price series itself — no synthetic penalty, no synthetic continuation
entry_exit_fills.no_survivorship_resubstitution: a dead name is never replaced by a successor entity's series; positions are event-anchored and simply terminate at their evidenced exit
entry_exit_fills.weights: equal-weight across active event positions; within each sector, long and short notional are equalized per date (only the min of the two sides is invested; CASH absorbs the imbalance); a sector contributes market exposure only when both sides are non-empty, so realized sector beta is ~0 without ETF legs; min 1 non-CASH leg per scored decision, min 30 scored decisions overall, min 5 scored decisions per fold

band_model_inherited.status: UNTRADABLE_AT_DECISION — excluded from eligibility at that decision (band_of, research/assets/stocks/kernel_band_cost_v9.py)

costs.charging: linear in fills (L-V14-0): fill_cost_bps = |dw| * band_bps * cost_mult / 10,000, charged exactly once per fill on traded notional, applied to booked PnL (never a sidecar); band from the trailing 63-session median dollar volume as of the decision (PIT); fail-closed band resolution (L-I3): a traded name without a computed band raises BandResolutionError — the silent 10 bps fallback is forbidden; fold force-flat exits charge the resolve_exit_band_bps C-rate ceiling when the band has decayed to UNTRADABLE
costs.stress: stress rerun at x2 base bps (20/30/50 per side); stress must remain positive on PnL with PF >= 1.0 — declared as the most likely honest failure mode, since dead-leg arrivals skew to band-B/C names where x2 costs bite hardest
costs.turnover_ceiling: 25 two-way per year, annualized, declared ex-ante for this event-book form: position life is 14 trading days by construction (bar-6 entry to bar-20 exit), so the V10 characteristic-book ceiling of 6.0x/yr is structurally unattainable for ANY honest event book; the event-clock form carries its own frozen single-number ceiling with every fill costed linearly and stress x2 applied; raw and ceiling-normalized turnover both reported

inputs: V11-E1-FILING-EVENT (arrival stamps + post-arrival bookable windows, first_avail, 800d)
SPDR sector ETF EOD series (residualization only)
arms.direction: long positive sector-residual initial reactions (underpriced arrivals), short negative ones (overpriced arrivals) — continuation of the incomplete first estimate
arms.data_space: {evidenced arrival stamps} + {entity EOD bars} + {sector ETF EOD bars for residualization}; zero fundamental fields, zero revision values, zero timeliness characteristics

arms.role: neighbour (supporting variant: the same continuation book with the reaction measured against SPY instead of the sector ETF — tests whether the diffusing content is market-relative firm information or sector-relative repricing)
arms.score: identical arithmetic with direction = sign of the 5-bar SPY-residual reaction (entity bars 1-5 return minus SPY return over the same dates)
arms.direction: same continuation direction rule as the anchor
arms.support_expectation: same sign as the anchor — both residualizations subtract the common market move, so firm-specific reaction content should survive either benchmark; if the neighbour flips sign while the anchor passes, the record states the effect is sector-relative repricing and the family is mechanism-mistitled, not rescued; if ONLY the neighbour works, the sector-residual frame is recorded as wrong — both branches are recorded failures of interpretation, not tunable outcomes

arms.role: control = sham-event placebo (the lane-mandatory control class; V5 sham-calendar lesson imported)
arms.score: for each anchor event (cik, first_avail): one deterministic hash-seeded sham event = a uniformly drawn (seed = sha256 of the ASCII string 'cik|first_avail') clear 20-bar window of that entity — a window that fits inside the entity's EOD series, contains NO bar date equal to any filer-event date of that entity (the P0 census section-d definition), and lies entirely within the SAME fold as the matched event; the SAME book arithmetic runs at the sham dates: pseudo-signal = sign of the 5-bar sector-residual reaction over sham-window bars 1-5, entry at sham bar-6 close, exit at sham bar-20 close, identical eligibility floors, identical weights and costs; 1:1 matching, one sham window per anchor event
inputs: V11-E1-FILING-EVENT (event stamps define which dates are FORBIDDEN for sham windows)
arms.direction: identical continuation rule at sham dates
arms.mechanism_refuted_if_reproduced: the mechanism claim is that the drift continuation is ANCHORED TO THE ARRIVAL: the initial reaction to a filing arrival is an incomplete estimate whose remainder diffuses over the following bars. The sham placebo runs the identical arithmetic at non-filing dates with matched 20-bar windows. If the sham control reproduces the anchor at >= 0.5x expectancy with the same sign, the continuation is generic short-horizon price mechanics available anywhere on the calendar — the arrival carries nothing, every convenient explanation survives, and the family DIES; a sham control that cannot run is a DESIGN FAILURE, not a pass (P3 mandate)
arms.differs_from_anchor_in_data_space: the control reads the identical observables at SHIFTED DATES: event-anchored windows are replaced by hash-seeded clear windows containing no event date; anchor and control entry dates are structurally distinct for the same entity (a sham window contains no filer-event date), so the two books are different position sets by construction, verified by the pre-selection rho gate below

exposure_definition: Per entity e and anchor event with arrival stamp a (gate = the evidenced first_avail, P-1) and decision date t = the bar-6 close date: (1) r_init(e,a) = prod(1 + r_e over STRICT bars 1-5) - 1 - [prod(1 + r_sector over the same 5 dates) - 1]; if any of the 5 entity dates or 5 sector-ETF dates is missing, or the sector tag is UNMAPPED, the event abstains-with-reason (counted). (2) exposure(e,t) = +1 if r_init > 0, -1 if r_init < 0, abstain-with-reason if r_init == 0 exactly. (3) The book at date t holds all active positions (entered, not yet exited), equal-weighted, with within-sector 0.5L/0.5S notional equalization and CASH absorbing imbalance. The neighbour exposure is defined identically with r_init measured against SPY. The control exposure is defined identically at hash-seeded sham window starts with matched 20-bar length. D2 RANKING CONTRACT: pooled Spearman rho of exposure(e,t) vs each of the ELEVEN veto entries computed on the SAME entity-decision pairs where the exposure is defined; pooled |rho| <= 0.20 required against all eleven (63-session prior return / generic + ETF-relative momentum, semivariance share, vol level, WC-stock intensity, Goodwill/Assets bloat, F1 accrual flow, depletion-runway interaction, Cash/Assets, sector-exposure form, V10 own_z deseasonalized-timing characteristic book, V10 revision-correction direction/breadth). DECLARED PRIMARY RISK: the 63-session momentum entry — the exposure shares short-horizon return content with it by construction of the reaction proxy; the design responses (arrival conditioning, 5-bar sector-residual window, sector-neutral book, no lookback rank anywhere) reduce but cannot eliminate the overlap, so the gate is MEASURED, never argued; a measured violation makes the proposal INELIGIBLE before selection.

pre_selection_identifiability_check.gate: anchor-vs-control pooled Spearman rho < 0.95 on the aligned (entity, calendar-date) cell grid over the three folds, coding each arm's position as +1/-1 where a position is open and 0 where flat or absent; rank identity is forbidden — the V4/V5 lesson (rho 0.78-0.83 caught pre-selection) is honored by measuring, never arguing
pre_selection_identifiability_check.declared_expectation: 0.0-0.3: the two arms share the sign-of-reaction arithmetic but their position dates are structurally disjoint for the same entity (a sham window contains no filer-event date), and sham windows are drawn uniformly over each entity's clear calendar rather than clustered at arrivals
pre_selection_identifiability_check.runnability_part: the sham control must RUN: control-arm non-vacuity floors identical to the anchor (>= 30 scored control decisions overall, >= 5 per fold, measured on the matched subset); a sham-event control that cannot run is a design failure, not a pass (P3 control_identifiability_pre_selection mandate)
pre_selection_identifiability_check.measurability: both quantities are computable from the PIT panel + price availability only (arrival stamps, EOD bars, sector tags); no outcome file is touched

incremental_alpha_test.spy_excess: per scored decision date, book return minus SPY return; REQUIRED: overall SPY-excess > 0 AND >= 2 of 3 folds positive — beta alone cannot pass (the V2 lesson)
incremental_alpha_test.sector_excess: book return minus a sector-matched benchmark: the notional-weighted average of the sector ETFs' same-date returns, weighted by the book's per-sector gross notional shares; REQUIRED: overall > 0 AND >= 2 of 3 folds positive — declared because the mechanism is firm-specific diffusion, not sector timing
incremental_alpha_test.etf_share_gate: no arm holds ETF legs (ETFs enter signals and benchmarks only, declared under clock.market_leg_inputs); the ETF-positive-share gate <= 0.50 is therefore measured as 0.00 by construction and reported with its margin (0.50) — declared here so the trivial pass is on the record before selection
incremental_alpha_test.positivity_requirement: SPY-excess positivity is a requirement of the family verdict: an anchor that passes expectancy/PF with negative SPY-excess is recorded as beta-contaminated and rejected

turnover_and_sample_floor.sample_floor: >= 30 scored decisions overall and >= 5 per fold (the P3 dry-run floors, cited verbatim: '>=30 scored decisions overall, >=5 per fold'), applied to anchor, neighbour AND control (the control on its matched subset); a family whose in-fold bookable event count misses the floors is BLOCKED_DATA_OR_SELECTION — the count is measurable from the pinned derived event artifact (sha256 728f14208cf29f419fe7bc5d2589a27b51c8f7033273a66fe7441c226f410fd9) before any PnL; given 69,696 pool-wide bookable events the floors are expected to clear by orders of magnitude, but no in-fold count is asserted here because none has been measured
turnover_and_sample_floor.turnover_ceiling: 25 two-way per year annualized (frozen single number, rationale under costs); raw and ceiling-normalized both reported with margin-to-fail
turnover_and_sample_floor.budget_note: one scored cell per arm-triplet is consumed only if the family is selected; max six scored cells cycle-wide, budget 0/6, unused slots never reassigned

drop_one_design: family-level robustness, preregistered: (i) symbol drop-one — rerun the anchor excluding the single largest PnL-contribution symbol; the family survives only if post-drop expectancy > 0 and the post-drop per-fold minimum expectancy > 0; (ii) fold leave-one-out — each fold removed in turn, overall expectancy reported with margins; (iii) sector drop-one — the largest-contribution sector removed, same criterion as (i); all three are reported with distance-to-threshold, none triggers remediation

novelty_declaration.measured_decorrelation_required: pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs every one of the ELEVEN veto entries, measured at D2 before selection on the pairs where the exposure is defined; anchor-vs-own-control rho allowed nonzero (shared sign arithmetic) but must be < 0.95 (not rank-identical)

literature: Ball, R. and Brown, P. (1968), 'An Empirical Evaluation of Accounting Income Numbers', Journal of Accounting Research 6(2) — the original announcement underreaction/drift evidence.

Bernard, V.L. and Thomas, J.K. (1990), 'Evidence that Stock Prices Do Not Fully Reflect the Implications of Current Earnings for Future Earnings', Journal of Accounting and Economics 13(4) — the drift as delayed price adjustment; grounds the continuation prediction.

Hong, H. and Stein, J.C. (1999), 'A Unified Theory of Underreaction, Momentum Trading, and Overreaction in Asset Markets', Journal of Finance 54(6) — gradual information diffusion across bounded-rational agents; the WHO/WHY of the mechanism.
Daniel, K., Hirshleifer, D. and Subrahmanyam, A. (1998), 'Investor Psychology and Security Market Under- and Overreactions', Journal of Finance 53(6) — underreaction to discrete information arrivals.

Hirshleifer, D. and Teoh, S.H. (2003), 'Limited Attention, Information Disclosure, and Financial Reporting', Journal of Accounting and Economics 36(1-3) — limited attention to disclosures; the lane's named lineage.

Hirshleifer, D., Lim, S.S. and Teoh, S.H. (2009), 'Driven to Distraction: Extraneous Events and Underreaction to Earnings News', Journal of Finance 64(5) — attention constraints slow incorporation of disclosed news.
Loh, R. (2010), 'Investor Inattention and the Underreaction to Stock News', Review of Financial Studies 23(2) — drift concentrates where attention is low; grounds the reaction-shape prediction.
Hong, H. and Stein, J.C. (2007), 'Disagreement and the Stock Market', Journal of Economic Perspectives 21(2) — unders/overreaction summary; supports the null as informative.
McLean, R.D. and Pontiff, J. (2016), 'Does Academic Research Destroy Stock Return Predictability?', Journal of Finance 71(1) — post-publication decay caveat: a null result is a legitimate outcome.
